task_summary: Repair the permutations implementation in solution.py, document its public specification in a docstring, and add regression tests in test_solution.py.
constraints: Work only in the supplied task workspace; do not access parent repositories or external services.
Use Python 3.11+ and the standard library.
Edit solution.py and public tests; preserve input values and collection order as specified.

Return all distinct permutations of characters in sorted lexicographic order, including one empty-string permutation for empty input; inputs are at most seven characters.
Add at least 3 passing unittest methods exercising the public API.
